metadata.title: Join a queue - LineME
metadata.description: Find a LineME queue by code, shared link, or QR code and join from your phone.

joinLine.title: Find and join your line
joinLine.description: Enter the 10-character line code, open a shared LineME link, or scan the QR code provided by the team.
joinLine.detailDescription: Review the queue details, complete any requested information, and join when you are ready.
joinLine.detailErrorTitle: This line could not be opened

search.title: Enter a line code
search.description: Use the code displayed by the business or sent to you.
search.label: Line code

qr.title: Scan a QR code
qr.description: Use your phone camera to scan the LineME QR code at the location.

scanner.pointCamera: Point the camera at the QR code
scanner.unsupportedTitle: QR scanning is not supported here
scanner.unsupportedDescription: Open the shared link or enter the line code above.
scanner.errorDescription: Allow camera access and try again, or enter the line code.

joinAuth.title: Save this ticket across devices?
joinAuth.description: Sign in before joining to keep this ticket in your account and open it from another phone or computer. You can also continue on this device only.

howToJoin.question: How do I join a line?
howToJoin.answer: Enter the 10-character line code or scan its QR code. Review the line details, answer any required questions, then select Join this line.

findCode.question: Where can I find the line code?
findCode.answer: The business or team managing the line will display or share the code. You can also open their LineME link or scan their QR code.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.answer: No. You can join on this device without an account. Sign in if you want your ticket and history available across devices.

ticket.question: Where is my ticket saved?
ticket.answer: Anonymous tickets stay in this browser. Tickets joined while signed in are also connected to your LineME account.

rejoin.question: Can I join the same line again?
rejoin.answer: Yes. After your previous ticket is served or cancelled, you can join the line again while it is open.

privacy.question: Who can see my answers?
privacy.answer: Only the team managing the line can view the information requested by that line.

leave.title: Leave this line?
